If the oil of pork's meat touched with something is it cleanable by water? thanks hope send the answer to my email. Question: Aslamulaikum, Dear, Is it permissible in Islam to cook pork meat for none mulism? if the cook doesn't cook this so he will lose his job too. If the oil of pork's meat touched with something is it cleanable by water? thanks hope send the answer to my email. Answer ID: 14966 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1162/236=TL/1430) It is unlawful for a Muslim to cook pork though for a non-Muslim. Such a person should keep on looking for lawful job and should leave this one when he finds a suitable one. (2) If his cloth was polluted with the oil of pork, he will have to wash it with water thrice and wring thrice in order to make is it clean and pure. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
